in_marathi.name: Bhawesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Living
in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhawesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Bhawesh is a Sanskrit name derived from Bhagavan, which means 'Lord'. The suffix 'esh' adds the meaning 'Living'. Thus, Bhawesh translates to 'Lord of Living'.

in_bengali.name: Bhawesh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of Living
in_bengali.long_meaning: Bhawesh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Bhawesh is a Sanskrit name derived from Bhagavan, which means 'Lord'. The suffix 'esh' adds the meaning 'Living'. Thus, Bhawesh translates to 'Lord of Living'.
